description.value: The Round-Up Motel is a two-storey property sitting right on Highway 97 (Cariboo Highway) at the south end of Clinton, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the historic Gold Rush Trail corridor. Rooms range from standard queen beds to full kitchen suites, and free parking accommodates vehicles towing trailers up to 50 feet. Clinton's small downtown — restaurants, pubs, a liquor store, grocery stores, and the Cariboo-area Clinton Museum — is all within easy walking distance of the motel.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record's name, address, and phone number. Room amenities are detailed on /rooms.html including free WiFi and in-wall USB charging ports; the /activities.html page confirms walking-distance access to restaurants, pubs, and grocery/convenience stores. No mention of bike-specific storage, tools, laundry, or e-bike charging anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational motel on Highway 97 with an active website, confirmed contact details, and walking-distance amenities useful to touring cyclists.

Nearby evening food.detail: Activities page lists 4 restaurants (including 2 Western-style and a Chinese restaurant with Saturday buffet), plus 2 pubs, all described as within walking distance of the motel

Nearby grocery.detail: Activities page lists 'Grocery and Convenience stores' as within walking distance

Device charging.detail: Rooms page lists 'In-Wall USB charging ports in each room' as a standard room amenity
